Mod.Name: Lobby Constellation Research
Mod.Description: Adds configurable extra constellation nodes in the lobby and restores purchased unlocks for mod-added nodes.
Description.DestructionExtraSlots: Number of extra constellation nodes added to the Destruction branch.
Description.LifeExtraSlots: Number of extra constellation nodes added to the Life branch.
Description.ImaginationExtraSlots: Number of extra constellation nodes added to the Imagination branch.
Description.FlexibleExtraSlots: Number of extra constellation nodes added to the Flexible branch.
Description.DestructionNodeScale: Visual scale multiplier applied to Destruction nodes.
Description.LifeNodeScale: Visual scale multiplier applied to Life nodes.
Description.ImaginationNodeScale: Visual scale multiplier applied to Imagination nodes.
Description.FlexibleNodeScale: Visual scale multiplier applied to Flexible nodes.
Description.NodePlacementSpacing: Spacing multiplier used when placing extra constellation nodes.
Description.DestructionNodeAngleDegrees: Rotate Destruction branch node positions around the center point by this many degrees.
Description.LifeNodeAngleDegrees: Rotate Life branch node positions around the center point by this many degrees.
Description.ImaginationNodeAngleDegrees: Rotate Imagination branch node positions around the center point by this many degrees.
Description.FlexibleNodeAngleDegrees: Rotate Flexible branch node positions around the center point by this many degrees.
Description.RestoreEquippedExtraStars: Restore stars equipped in mod-added extra slots after the base game clears them during startup.
Description.RestorePurchasedUnlocks: Restore purchased extra node unlocks when the game starts before this mod is loaded.
Description.AdjustStardustOnRestore: When restoring refunded unlocks, subtract the refunded stardust again to keep the save consistent.
Description.EnableExperimentalOverTenLay: Allow a branch to exceed 10 total nodes. This is experimental and may break the lobby constellation UI.
